metadata.sizeJustification: The operator decomposed epic PAN-2350 into sibling issues and assigned W-WORK1, W-WORK2, W-WORK4, W-WORK5, W-WORK6, W-WORK7, W-WORK8 and MCP fleet reach to this issue as one unit. They share the work-door module, the fleet routes, the placement service and the heartbeat additions, so the 31 items are already the vertical slices of that unit; the file and subsystem counts are inflated by one test file per source file and by the docs pages each counting as a subsystem (siblings #4645 and #4650 used the same shape).

narratives.Problem: Linked machines (PAN-4645/4650) can see and remote-control each other's conversations, but nothing starts work on another machine, follows delegated work back, chooses a machine by load or capability, groups projects by repository, or shows Needs-You, search, usage and settings across the fleet; the MCP server reaches only this machine.
narratives.Proposal: Owner-side work doors (/api/machines/work/*) stamp link-started provenance and a narrowed agent fence; viewer-side fleet routes (/api/fleet/*) resolve this machine, a label or Auto (deterministic D-19 placement over heartbeat load, tags and project lists) and forward over the link; delegated workers get a local stand-in kept in step by a follower; projects, Needs-You and load arrive by hash-driven heartbeat sync; search, usage, compare and 'who' fan out per action; odk_ tokens reach linked conversations under a scope ceiling. Details: .pan/drafts/PAN-4651.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Running gauntlet lanes on another machine (W-WORK3, PAN-4638); this issue adds only the lane flags and placement.
- --machine fly, the Fly (new VM) choice and any remote.auto_fly key (PAN-4652).
- A stop cascade for local (non-delegated) workers.
- Usage per provider account beyond duplicate request ids.
- Changing settings on another machine; Compare settings is read-only.
- Comparing defaults that neither machine sets, or projects.yaml.
- A dashboard view for 'which machine is working on PAN-<n>' (CLI and fleet route only).
- Answering a remote work agent's pending input inline from Needs-You.
- Capability tags in the public environment descriptor.
- Copying files larger than 1 MiB, directories or symlinks between machines.
- Polling linked machines on a timer for projects, Needs-You or load.
- Raising any file-size allowlist cap.

autoDecisions.summary: Owner-side work doors under /api/machines/work/* (machine credential only, operate scope) start link-started conversations, workers, issue agents and projects; viewer-side /api/fleet/* routes resolve the machine and forward.
autoDecisions.rationale: pan start and pan worker run spawn in the CLI process and POST /api/agents needs admin, which machine tokens never carry; a dedicated door stamps provenance in one place without editing god files.

autoDecisions.summary: Agent actors may change only conversations and workers their own machine started (started_by_environment_id / worker.json startedBy); bare POST /api/conversations, /api/workers and /api/lanes stay refused to agent actors over a link.
autoDecisions.rationale: Epic FR-4 states this rule literally; forcing link-started work through the work doors keeps every such item stamped.

autoDecisions.summary: Delegated workers get a local stand-in directory with remote.json and mirrored reports, kept in step by a dashboard follower with 1 s to 300 s back-off that resumes from disk and stops the remote worker when the parent dies.
autoDecisions.rationale: pan worker wait and the parent already read report files; a stand-in reuses that path unchanged and survives dashboard restarts (epic FR-11).

autoDecisions.summary: Unpushed commits make remote pan start / pan worker run exit 1 unless --push-first or --ignore-unpushed.
autoDecisions.rationale: Epic D-11 says the CLI 'says so and offers --push-first'; refusing by default prevents a delegated agent from silently working on stale code.

autoDecisions.summary: Load, capability tags and placement mode ride in the authenticated 15 s heartbeat, not in the public environment descriptor.
autoDecisions.rationale: GET /api/environment needs no credential and operator tags can name a purpose; the heartbeat already carries per-link facts to the supervisor.

autoDecisions.summary: 'Running agents' for placement counts live-agent-directory entries in state 'working'.
autoDecisions.rationale: Same definition the fleet-update turn wait uses; idle agents do not load the machine.

autoDecisions.summary: --machine fly and the Fly (new VM) choice are refused / shown disabled with 'needs PAN-4652'; no remote.auto_fly key is added.
autoDecisions.rationale: Fly VMs are not machines until #4652 (W-FLY2) ships; the issue lists that dependency.

autoDecisions.summary: pan lane start gains --machine and --needs with placement; a remote choice exits 1 naming PAN-4638.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue assigns W-WORK3 (lanes on other machines) to #4638, which consumes this flag and the placement service.

autoDecisions.summary: MCP odk_ calls through a link are forwarded as actor operator with a ceiling equal to the token's scopes; the token's scopes are the fence.
autoDecisions.rationale: Resolves the tension between epic FR-4 (agents change only link-started conversations) and FR-27/AC-12 (an MCP client messages a desktop conversation); D-21 defines MCP fencing as no pairing, token minting or settings plus the approve scope, which the ceiling enforces.

autoDecisions.summary: Lowering the @-prefix proxy from admin to per-path scopes is paired with an explicit no-chained-hops refusal for channel callers.
autoDecisions.rationale: The admin default was the only guard against a machine credential hopping through the proxy.

autoDecisions.summary: Fleet usage dedups by duplicate provider request id (hashed digest), not by a provider account.
autoDecisions.rationale: cost_events has no account column; the only real cross-machine double count is the same request recorded on two machines; with no overlap the total equals the sum (the epic done-when).

autoDecisions.summary: Compare settings compares explicitly set config.yaml keys (dotted snake_case) and emits 'pan admin config set <key> <value>' lines; a minimal pan admin config set is added.
autoDecisions.rationale: pan config set does not exist and config lives under pan admin config; comparing set keys keeps every key name exactly what the command writes.

autoDecisions.summary: Add this project works both ways: 'here' runs locally with admin, 'there' goes through an operator-only owner work door; selected git-ignored files cross only operator-level links with the operator actor.
autoDecisions.rationale: Epic FR-12 names 'Add this project to <machine>' as the delegation error's remedy, which needs the remote direction; .env files are secrets.

autoDecisions.summary: The Combine matching repositories setting lives in anywhere.json next to shareConversations.
autoDecisions.rationale: The Settings whole-document save is lossy (PAN-4650 D-4650-15) and the setting is per machine.

autoDecisions.summary: One issue with 31 items instead of sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator already decomposed epic PAN-2350 into sibling issues and assigned these work items to this one; siblings #4650 and #4645 used the same shape.
